newsitem.title: CANADA: Grandma Lee's to acquire real estate firm.
newsitem.headline: Grandma Lee's to acquire real estate firm.

text.p: Grandma Lee's Inc said on Thursday it had agreed to acquire the Churchill Heights Properties Ltd real estate investment company from Dixtor Investments Ltd.

The net value of the common shares Grandma Lee's will acquire is anticipated to be between C$9.5-11.5 million, Grandma Lee's said. The transaction's closing date is tentatively scheduled for a January 20, 1997 shareholder's meeting.
Grandma Lee's also said they will appoint Jerry Janik as their new chief executive officer. Janik is currently the chief executive officer of Churchill Heights.
Shares in the restaurant franchisor added 1.5 cents to end at 0.30 in heavy volume on the Toronto Stock Exchange by close of trading Thursday.
